tool_limitations.limitation: Its `dotnet build` healthcheck reported '0 WUI analyzer warnings' while the benchmark's `winapp build` emitted WUI1001 on the same picker code — the two builds surface different WUI rulesets, so the validator's WUI gate can pass while winapp build shows advisories.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Distinguish fatal WUI000x from benign WUI1xxx interop advisories and note winapp build is the authoritative WUI surface.

doc_errors.wrong: 'Treat every warning WUI000\d line ... the analyzer does not produce false positives' — omits the WUI1xxx advisory family entirely (only WUI0002/0003/0004 documented).
doc_errors.correct: WUI1xxx (e.g. WUI1001 pickers) is an advisory class that persists even after the correct InitializeWithWindow interop is applied and is benign — distinct from WUI000x runtime-crash residue.

special_apis.special_handling: Requires WinRT.Interop.WindowNative.GetWindowHandle + InitializeWithWindow.Initialize; the WUI1001 analyzer warning still fires on the type usage afterward (syntactic rule) but the picker works — confirmed by parity pass (picker opened).
Replaces UWP OnFileActivated/OnActivated; agent captured it in OnLaunched into a static App.InitialActivationArgs for scenario pages (App.xaml.cs).
Preserved verbatim from UWP manifest into the WinUI3 Package.appxmanifest; these <uap:Extension> declarations carry over unchanged and are required for the association scenarios.
